user.title: HDMI Matrix hub
user.description: Enter the address of the HDMI Matrix hub (the Docker container that controls your OREI matrix), not the matrix itself.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the hub.
data_description.port: Port of the hub's web interface and REST API (8080 by default).

reconfigure.title: Change the hub address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the hub that controls this matrix.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the hub.
data_description.port: Port of the hub's web interface and REST API (8080 by default).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the hub. Check the host and port, and that the hub is running.

abort.wrong_device: The hub at this address controls a different matrix.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant reads the matrix state from the hub (5-300 seconds).
